scope: Local only; no platform actions; no edits to previous frozen sources.
evidence_before_this_file: Agent DEV results for parity_decay64 and primal_window256 already observed. No new calibration/final policy outcomes observed.
development: Previous closed-ready calibration64+final128 are DEV192, not independent. Open15 is an explicit weighted objective, not hidden validation.
search_budget: At most 4 core hypotheses total (2 agent + 2 primary), and at most 1 causal combination. No threshold grid. One metadata handoff repair is tracked separately.
hypotheses: primal opportunity cost at moderate population
one evidence-driven primary hypothesis if needed

gates.correctness: All cases valid; CPU<5s and RSS<256MiB on local one-worker interactive evaluation. Target Windows/G5420 remains unverified.
gates.development: Reject a core with any DEV KPI loss >0.10 or negative ordinary mean. Select at most 2 core candidates for calibration.
gates.calibration: Require ordinary family-macro improvement >=0.001, prefix macro >= baseline-0.002, and no individual relative retention <0.85. Compare weighted Open15+84*macro at prefix mix 0 and 1; minimax regret with 0.05 tie toward simpler online.
gates.freeze: Select at most one core and online/hybrid policy before opening final outcomes. No changes after final.
gates.final: Confirm positive ordinary family-macro, prefix macro >= baseline-0.002, no retention <0.85, positive equal-stratum mean, and positive total-score sensitivity at both prefix endpoints relative to previous online. Otherwise no core promotion.
gates.uncertainty: Synthetic evidence only, not official hidden-score proof. Report paired family bootstrap, per-stratum outcomes, worst losses, and Open15 tradeoffs.
